subject: Request: Trial respite + credits after SDK rollback — ApexRetail POC
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena@apexretail.com>
To: david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-16T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Urgent: POC blocked after SDK rollback — need trial extension

Hi David,

We rolled back to the previous SDK this morning after the 3.4.1 client caused failures in our cart reconciliation lambda. The rollback fixed the immediate error, but the integration work has set us back by at least two sprints. Samir and I ran a quick impact assessment — several of our end-to-end tests rely on the newer tokenization behavior and we'll need engineering time to refactor.

Given this delay, can Redwood provide a two-week trial extension and a small credits top-up so we can resume the POC without the team having to re-provision capacity? We have the integration logs and a screenshot of the failing request attached (integration_logs.zip, error_screenshot.png).

We appreciate the quick response — our execs want to keep the demo window in the first week of September if possible.

Thanks,
Elena Park
Head of Integrations, Apex Retail
elena@apexretail.com

On Sun, Aug 16, 2026 at 08:02 David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Elena — got your note. Can you confirm whether you rolled back the runtime or the client library? If it's the client SDK, we may be able to provide a compatibility shim to reduce the refactor scope.
> 
> Also cc'ing Neha (CS) and Ben (Sales) to scope the credits/extension request.
> 
> —David
From: david_kim@redwood.ai
To: Elena Park <elena@apexretail.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-16T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: POC blocked after SDK rollback — need trial extension

Elena — thanks for the quick context and for the attachments. I pulled the logs you sent (thanks) — it looks like the issue is the tokenization delta we shipped in v3.4.1; several request shapes changed and your reconciliation lambda depends on an implicit token boundary we adjusted.

Short plan: 1) I can coordinate a targeted shim we can push to your integration repo this week to emulate the prior behavior; 2) If you prefer the team to refactor to v3.4.x semantics, we should plan for ~2 weeks of engineering effort depending on test coverage.

From a commercial perspective, Ben/Neha — can we approve a two-week trial extension plus a 20k token credit top-up for Apex Retail to keep the POC demo window? If there are internal approval notes you need, I'm happy to add details here.

Elena — if you want us to try the shim path, share a short pairing window (1 hour) and your repo access scope.

Best,
David Kim
Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: david_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-16T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: POC blocked after SDK rollback — need trial extension

Team — I reviewed the account play and timeline. Apex Retail is at demo stage and the exec ask is firm (first week Sep). I'm supportive of a short-term runway fix.

Requesting formal approval for:
- 2-week trial extension (dates: 2026-08-17 to 2026-08-31)
- 20k token credit top-up to cover rebuild and re-run of tests

Neha — please confirm you'll own the mutual action plan delivery and verify the MPL (mutual_action_plan.docx) milestones.

Lauren — looping you for approvals on the credit and extension; if this needs legal/finance sign-off we should be explicit.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales Manager
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Elena Park <elena@apexretail.com>, david_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-17T09:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: POC blocked after SDK rollback — need trial extension

Hi Elena — thanks for the attachments. I reviewed the mutual_action_plan.docx and added two checkpoints: shim test and post-refactor validation. I can run weekly syncs and own the acceptance criteria.

For the immediate unblock, I'd like to schedule a 60-minute pairing session with David and your engineering lead (Samir). Proposed times: Tue 8/17 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 8/18 14:00–15:00 PT. Which works?

Also confirming we'll need the repo token or a short-lived service account to deploy the shim — please share the access via a secure link.

Neha Kapoor
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-08-18T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: POC blocked after SDK rollback — need trial extension

Ben / Neha / David — approved.

We will:
- Grant a 2-week trial extension for Apex Retail (2026-08-17 through 2026-08-31)
- Issue a one-time 20,000-token credit top-up to the Apex Retail trial account (deal APL-2026-0921)

Notes: this is an exception to standard practice due to the SDK regression introduced in v3.4.1 and the clear demo timeline. Marking as conditional on: mutual_action_plan.docx milestones being met and a short post-demo adoption check-in. Finance has been notified; no contract amendment required for this one-time top-up.

Ben — please notify the customer and update HubSpot. Neha — proceed with the pairing session and milestone tracking.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
